lines.zh: 亚麻胸甲贴在身上，比铁轻
lines.en: The linen cuirass sits lighter than iron on me.

lines.zh: 我踩着沙土走，脚下没有铁响
lines.en: I walk on sand with no iron clatter underfoot.

lines.zh: 圆盾挂在左臂，随步子晃
lines.en: The round shield sways on my left arm as I go.

lines.zh: Falcata 在腰侧，只轻轻碰腿
lines.en: The falcata taps my thigh, softly.

lines.zh: 亚麻压着肩膀，透气又结实
lines.en: Linen presses my shoulder, breathable and tough.

lines.zh: 我绕过热沙，找有阴的地方
lines.en: I skirt the hot sand, seeking shade.

lines.zh: 十点护甲，走路不敢太横
lines.en: Ten armor; I dare not swagger.

lines.zh: 我把额上的汗抹到袖口
lines.en: I wipe my brow on my sleeve.

lines.zh: 矛扛在肩，头上绑着布条
lines.en: Spear on my shoulder, cloth wound round the shaft.

lines.zh: 我走得慢，怕磨破胸甲的边
lines.en: I walk slow lest the cuirass edge fray.

lines.zh: 沙粒钻进鞋缝，我抖了抖脚
lines.en: Sand gets into my shoes; I shake my foot.

lines.zh: 我贴着一排矮树走
lines.en: I walk along a row of low shrubs.

lines.zh: 风吹开胸甲的下摆
lines.en: Wind lifts the hem of my cuirass.

lines.zh: 我停了停，把盾带收紧
lines.en: I pause to tighten the shield strap.

lines.zh: 亚麻的纹路被汗浸深了
lines.en: Sweat darkens the weave of my linen.

lines.zh: 我抬脚跨过一块碎石
lines.en: I lift a foot over a shard of rock.

lines.zh: 我把矛插在沙里，靠着休息
lines.en: I plant my spear in the sand and lean on it.

lines.zh: 亚麻胸甲晒得暖烘烘的
lines.en: The sun warms my linen cuirass through.

lines.zh: 盾提在膝前，像一面小桌
lines.en: My shield rests at my knee like a small table.

lines.zh: 我不太想打仗，只想坐着
lines.en: I would rather sit than fight.

lines.zh: 远处的队伍走散了，我留下
lines.en: The line has scattered; I remain.

lines.zh: 我把头盔摘下来扇风
lines.en: I take off my helm and fan myself.

lines.zh: 手指沿着盾沿慢慢划一圈
lines.en: My finger traces the shield rim once.

lines.zh: 亚麻上的线头被我拽直
lines.en: I pull a loose thread straight.

lines.zh: 我听见自己呼吸很轻
lines.en: I hear how light my own breathing is.

lines.zh: 太阳偏了，我换了个脚站
lines.en: The sun shifts; I change my standing foot.

lines.zh: 我把矛尖插进土里磨钝
lines.en: I work the point into the soil to blunt it.

lines.zh: 亚麻的边卷起来了，我压平
lines.en: The linen edge has curled; I press it flat.

lines.zh: 我把盾翻过来晒太阳
lines.en: I turn the shield over to catch the sun.

lines.zh: 沙里有什么在动，我看了一眼
lines.en: Something moves in the sand; I glance at it.

lines.zh: 我数着远处驼铃一样的响
lines.en: I count a sound like distant camel bells.

lines.zh: 我把腰上的布条重新系紧
lines.en: I retie the cloth strip at my waist.

lines.zh: 我从盾后看你，没什么敌意
lines.en: I look at you over my shield, not unfriendly.

lines.zh: 你身上没有甲，我放松了手
lines.en: You wear no armor; my grip loosens.

lines.zh: 亚麻胸甲挡得住一刀吗
lines.en: Will this linen stop one blade? Perhaps.

lines.zh: 我把盾抬了一点，挡住胸口
lines.en: I raise the shield a little to cover my chest.

lines.zh: 你不像坏人，可我不敢赌
lines.en: You do not look wicked, but I will not gamble.

lines.zh: 矛尖垂着，没有指向你
lines.en: My point hangs low, not aimed at you.

lines.zh: 亚麻胸甲下面，我的眼睛盯着你的剑。
lines.en: Beneath this linen cuirass, my eyes are fixed on your blade.

lines.zh: 这么近，我数得清你的睫毛
lines.en: This close I could count your lashes.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，给你留路
lines.en: I step back half a pace to leave you room.

lines.zh: 亚麻下面全是汗
lines.en: Under the linen I am all sweat.

lines.zh: 我把矛往脚边一插，等你说话
lines.en: I plant the spear by my foot and wait for you to speak.

lines.zh: 你的手没有握兵器，我看见了
lines.en: Your hand holds no weapon; I noticed.

lines.zh: 亚麻被割开一道口子
lines.en: A gash opens in my linen.

lines.zh: 盾震得我整条臂发麻
lines.en: The shield's blow numbs my whole arm.

lines.zh: 我弯下腰，喘不上气
lines.en: I double over, unable to catch breath.

lines.zh: 胸甲的边割进我的肋
lines.en: The cuirass edge cuts into my ribs.

lines.zh: 我后退时踩空了一步
lines.en: I miss a step as I retreat.

lines.zh: 矛没握住，差点落地
lines.en: I nearly lose the spear.

lines.zh: 这一下疼得我眼冒金星
lines.en: The blow scatters stars before my eyes.

lines.zh: 血渗进亚麻的纹里
lines.en: Blood seeps into the weave.

lines.zh: 我咬着牙把矛捡回来
lines.en: I grit my teeth and retrieve my spear.

lines.zh: 盾带勒进我的手腕
lines.en: The shield strap bites into my wrist.

lines.zh: 你拿的是麦饼吗，闻着真香
lines.en: Is that flatbread? It smells wonderful.

lines.zh: 我咽了口口水，盾都低了
lines.en: I swallow hard and my shield dips.

lines.zh: 走了一整天，胃里空得慌
lines.en: A whole day walking leaves my stomach hollow.

lines.zh: 我不抢，只站在这里等你给
lines.en: I will not snatch; I just stand and wait.

lines.zh: 那袋果子晃得我眼睛发直
lines.en: That sack of fruit makes my eyes fix.

lines.zh: 亚麻甲里全是饿出来的汗
lines.en: The hunger sweat soaks my linen.

lines.zh: 先吃，再谈打仗的事
lines.en: We eat first, then talk of fighting.

lines.zh: 我把矛靠在肩上，空出手来
lines.en: I rest the spear on my shoulder to free a hand.

lines.zh: 一口就够，我不贪心
lines.en: One bite is enough; I am not greedy.

lines.zh: 我看了看你，又看了看饼
lines.en: I look at you, then at the bread.

lines.zh: 你分我一半，我替你挡一刀
lines.en: Half of that, and I will take a blow for you.

lines.zh: 这么香的饼，谁舍得打仗
lines.en: Bread this good—who would choose a fight?

lines.zh: 我闻到油的味道，肚子叫了
lines.en: I smell oil and my stomach answers.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西，我盯了很久
lines.en: I have stared a long while at what you hold.

lines.zh: 亚麻甲里空得能听见回声
lines.en: My cuirass is so empty I hear an echo.

lines.zh: 我把盾斜着放，好伸手
lines.en: I tilt the shield aside to free my hand.

lines.zh: 你撞到我的圆盾上，弹开了
lines.en: You hit my round shield and bounce away.

lines.zh: 亚麻下面还是骨头，撞着也疼
lines.en: Beneath the linen is bone, and it hurts.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，我退了两步
lines.en: We collide and I give two steps.

lines.zh: 矛杆横在中间，隔开我们
lines.en: The shaft lies between us, keeping us apart.

lines.zh: 盾沿磕到你的手腕
lines.en: The shield rim clips your wrist.

lines.zh: 别挤，这甲经不起扯
lines.en: Do not shove; this cuirass will not take tugging.

lines.zh: 我的脚陷进沙里，站稳了
lines.en: My foot sinks in sand and holds.

lines.zh: 相撞时我听见线绷紧的声
lines.en: At the impact I hear the linen strain.

lines.zh: 我把盾一偏，卸掉你的力
lines.en: I angle the shield and shed your force.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的盾面，滑了一下
lines.en: You step on my shield face and slip.

lines.zh: 她替我把胸甲上的结解开一半
lines.en: She loosens half the knot on my cuirass.

lines.zh: 我们坐在同一块石头上
lines.en: We sit on the same stone.

lines.zh: 亚麻碰着亚麻，声音很轻
lines.en: Linen brushes linen, barely a sound.

lines.zh: 她把我的盾立在两人之间
lines.en: She props my shield between us.

lines.zh: 没人说话，风吹着胸甲的边
lines.en: No one speaks; wind worries the cuirass hem.

lines.zh: 她数我肩上的旧伤
lines.en: She counts the old scars on my shoulder.

lines.zh: 我说这甲轻，她说轻才好跑
lines.en: I say the armor is light; she says light runs better.

lines.zh: 两只手一起把矛扶正
lines.en: Two hands set the spear upright together.

lines.zh: 我们约好明天换班
lines.en: We agree to trade watches tomorrow.

lines.zh: 她笑的时候，盾也晃了晃
lines.en: When she laughs, the shield sways too.

lines.zh: 我蹲下捡起掉落的麦粒
lines.en: I crouch and pick up fallen wheat grains.

lines.zh: 盾立在沙上，我腾出双手
lines.en: Shield propped in the sand, both hands free.

lines.zh: 我拾起一截断掉的矛杆
lines.en: I pick up a broken length of shaft.

lines.zh: 亚麻口袋里又多了块石头
lines.en: Another stone goes into my linen pouch.

lines.zh: 捡起你的水袋，我摇了摇
lines.en: I pick up your waterskin and shake it.

lines.zh: 我把散落的箭一支支收好
lines.en: I gather the scattered arrows one by one.

lines.zh: 蹲下时胸甲顶住了下巴
lines.en: Crouching, my cuirass jabs my chin.

lines.zh: 我捡起一块能磨矛的石头
lines.en: I pick up a stone that can hone a spear.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的铜扣，我扣回去
lines.en: I refasten a bronze clasp that fell.

lines.zh: 我拾起一片断掉的亚麻
lines.en: I pick up a scrap of torn linen.

lines.zh: 我把盾转正，矛尖压低
lines.en: I square the shield and drop the point.

lines.zh: 你走近了，我不能再躲
lines.en: You came close; I can no longer hide.

lines.zh: 亚麻甲不是铁甲，可我敢上
lines.en: Linen is not iron, but I will still go.

lines.zh: 我侧身站定，让你看见盾
lines.en: I turn side-on so you see the shield.

lines.zh: 距离刚好一矛，我记住了
lines.en: Exactly one spear away; I have marked it.

lines.zh: 我的手指在矛杆上收紧
lines.en: My fingers tighten on the shaft.

lines.zh: 你手里的兵器我看清了
lines.en: I have seen the weapon in your hand.

lines.zh: 我往前挪了半步，沙在响
lines.en: I shift half a step and the sand whispers.

lines.zh: 这一战躲不掉，那就打
lines.en: This fight will not pass; then we fight.

lines.zh: 我把头盔的带子系紧
lines.en: I cinch the strap of my helm.

lines.zh: 我跟着你转，盾始终朝前
lines.en: I turn with you, shield always forward.

lines.zh: 你走一步，我挪半步
lines.en: You take a step; I take half.

lines.zh: 亚麻甲轻，我能绕着你跑
lines.en: The linen is light; I can circle you.

lines.zh: 我不冒进，先看你怎么出招
lines.en: I hold back and watch how you strike.

lines.zh: 矛尖在你膝前晃，试你的反应
lines.en: My point wavers at your knee, testing you.

lines.zh: 你抬盾，我就打你的腿
lines.en: You raise your shield; I go for your legs.

lines.zh: 沙地软，你的脚步会陷
lines.en: Sand is soft; your steps will sink.

lines.zh: 我把盾压低，护住下盘
lines.en: I drop the shield to guard my legs.

lines.zh: 你转身的时候背对了我
lines.en: You turned your back to me.

lines.zh: 距离一直在缩，你没察觉
lines.en: The gap keeps closing and you have not noticed.

lines.zh: 矛尖从盾沿上方刺出去
lines.en: The point stabs out above my shield rim.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，从下往上挑
lines.en: I drop low and cut upward.

lines.zh: Falcata 出鞘，一道弧光
lines.en: The falcata clears its sheath in an arc.

lines.zh: 你用盾挡矛，我用盾撞你
lines.en: You block the spear; I hit you with the shield.

lines.zh: 矛刺空了，我立刻退半步
lines.en: The thrust misses; I give half a step.

lines.zh: 我的脚在沙里打了个滑
lines.en: My foot skids in the sand.

lines.zh: 青铜尖划过你的袖口
lines.en: The bronze tip slices your sleeve.

lines.zh: 盾面拍在你脸上，声音很脆
lines.en: My shield slaps your face with a crack.

lines.zh: 我连着刺了两下，第二下偏低
lines.en: I thrust twice; the second comes in low.

lines.zh: 你用兵器格开，我顺势转身
lines.en: You parry; I spin with it.

lines.zh: 亚麻胸甲还带着织机的味道
lines.en: My linen cuirass still smells of the loom.

lines.zh: 我从沙丘后面走出来
lines.en: I come out from behind a dune.

lines.zh: 盾在日光下泛着旧木的颜色
lines.en: My shield shows old wood in the sun.

lines.zh: 我把矛往地上一顿，站稳
lines.en: I stamp the spear down and settle.

lines.zh: 风把我的胸甲吹得鼓起来
lines.en: Wind billows my cuirass.

lines.zh: 我不是最硬的兵，但我来了
lines.en: I am not the toughest soldier, but I am here.

lines.zh: 十点护甲，一身亚麻
lines.en: Ten armor, all linen.

lines.zh: 有人需要挡一剑的，就是我
lines.en: Whoever needs a blow taken, that is me.

lines.zh: 我把盾上的沙拍掉
lines.en: I knock the sand off my shield.

lines.zh: 矛尖朝天，我先站稳
lines.en: Spear tip skyward, I steady my feet first.

lines.zh: 火一沾亚麻，整片都烧起来
lines.en: Fire catches the linen and the whole sheet burns.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滚下，盾先撞地
lines.en: I roll down the slope, shield striking first.

lines.zh: 水浸透亚麻，我越来越沉
lines.en: Water soaks the linen and I grow heavier.

lines.zh: 爆风撕开我的胸甲
lines.en: The blast rips my cuirass open.

lines.zh: 一支箭穿进亚麻，扎到肉
lines.en: An arrow pierces the linen and bites flesh.

lines.zh: 咒力钻进胸口，我腿一软
lines.en: Magic sinks into my chest and my legs give.

lines.zh: 饿了太久，我举不起盾
lines.en: Too long hungry; I cannot lift the shield.

lines.zh: 雷打在矛上，一路窜到我肩
lines.en: Lightning strikes the spear and runs into my shoulder.

lines.zh: 脚下没有沙了，我一路往下
lines.en: The sand is gone; I keep falling.
